chunks: Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated, saying: Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
"The year is twelve months; an Umrah may be performed in each month."

key_terms.اثْنَا عَشَرَ: twelve, specifying the number of months in the year
key_terms.السَّنَةُ: the year, referring to the full twelve-month cycle
key_terms.شَهْرًا: a month, the recurring unit of time in which Umrah may be performed
key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ: the minor pilgrimage performed outside the specific rites of hajj
key_terms.يُعْتَمَرُ: Umrah is performed, indicating permissibility or practice

ai.seo_question: Can Umrah be performed every month according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the year consists of twelve months and indicates the permissibility of performing one Umrah in each month. It serves as a jurisprudential basis for the minimum interval between repeated Umrah performances.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2964 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated that Abu Abdullah (as) said:
"The year has twelve months, and an Umrah can be performed in each month."
